messages:
emma: Quick huddle re: webinar creative + battlecard updates. Main asks: 1) one crisp hero line + one verifiable metric variant for A/B; 2) concise rebut stack for SDRs vs cloud-managed endpoints and open-runtime vendors; 3) routing tags so we can tie performance-claim variants back to conversions. Drafts in drive: https://docs.google.com/zzz — please comment.

rishi: Read the draft. Proposal for A/B subhead metric: A = 'up to 30% lower token cost' (careful with 'up to'), B = 'reduced 95p latency under burst'. Legal will want the qualifier and methodology link.

dana: For SDR rebuttals vs managed endpoints: keep it tight. My suggested 3-second counters: 1) Ops surprise costs -> "Redwood exposes and controls unit economics with routing + cache policies"; 2) Slow tails on spikes -> "Predictable tail latency via routing & KV caching"; 3) Hard rollouts -> "Canary rollouts + automatic fallback to keep apps online."

tom: For open-runtime vendor angle (self-hosted runtimes): highlight the operational overhead and lack of multi-tenant routing/benchmarks. Example counter: "You can run an open runtime, but Redwood gives the same low-level controls with hosted observability, SLA options, and reserved capacity."

rishi: Routing plan snippet for form handler (tracking both channel and hero variant):
```
if source == 'webinar':
  team = 'sdr-webinar'
  tags += [ 'webinar', 'hero_variant:A' or 'hero_variant:B' ]
  if interest == 'infra':
    tags += ['interest:infra']
```
We need a small enum field in the signup form for "Reason for interest" to help routing.

emma: Good. Ops: can you make sure the tag names map to SFDC fields? We want to tie hero_variant -> campaign creative in reports.

opsbot: Reminder: webinar creative freeze Thu EOD. Routing PR to staging by Fri AM to allow tests.

rishi: Measurement note: add a click-through CTA that includes ?claim=A or ?claim=B so marketing analytics can validate which creative drove SQLs.

dana: Battlecard layout idea: top-line claim, 2-line value prop, 3 rapid rebuttals, 1 field-facing methodology blurb with link to locked appendix. Keep it to 1 page.

tom: Legal note: I'll submit for review. Any percent number needs a contextual line and a link to methodology. For public slides we can say "material reductions" and reserve percents for SDR appendix.

emma: Action items recap:
- Rishi: add hero_variant enum to signup form + tagging PR (due Thu)
- Tom: legal review for percent claims + language (due Wed)
- Dana: finalize 3 rebut lines and hand to design for one-pager (due Wed noon)
- Ops: implement tags in staging and make sure SFDC mapping exists (due Fri AM)

opsbot: Assets deadline reminder: one-pager + landing copy + benchmark appendix by Thu EOD.

emma: Thanks team. We'll run the creative A/B for the landing page and push follow-up flows tied to tags so SDRs get the right play. Keep rebuttals short and practiceable. :sparkles:
